name: MithrilUI
$comment: The safe default: art only, no layout overrides.
Replacing art cannot break anything -- worst case a panel looks wrong and
you switch skins back. Layout modules move real UI elements and depend on
your screen resolution, so they are opt-in (see declutter.json).

$sweepCatchAll: OFF, and this is the most important setting in the project.
The catch-all clears every asset no named rule recognised. It is where
the minimal look comes from, and it is also where every regression came
from: black blocks over the portrait, invisible toolbar buttons, a
broken loading progress bar. Each was a different unknown asset, found
only by someone hitting it in game.
About 450 assets cannot be identified from their name alone, and an
unverifiable rule that silently deletes interface elements is not worth
the ornament it removes. With it off, only assets a named rule actually
recognises get touched -- still around 1450 of them.
